operations.title: Paired deck Mackey norm and integral normalization obstruction
Exact cyclic-surjection Mackey norm and C2 normalization gate
operations.method: Exhaust cyclic surjections C_n->C_m for m|n, n<=12, checking pull-push multiplicity, upstairs kernel norms, N_K quadratic relation, coefficient-Betti adjunction, and C2 symmetric-weight incompatibility.

operations.title: Paired finite-deck correspondences carry an integral kernel norm that obstructs simultaneous frozen selection and normalized ambidexterity
operations.body: For a surjective finite deck homomorphism q with K=ker q, q_!q^* and q_*q^! equal |K| times identity downstairs, while q^*q_! and q^!q_* equal N_K upstairs and N_K^2=|K|N_K. For C2->1, frozen delta normalization forces transfer weight 1 while normalized ambidexterity forces 1/2. Algebraic Mackey/Beck-Chevalley survives; physical cross-deck naturality remains unadmitted without relative-chain q_*.

operations.outcome: pass: 801 downstairs pull-push scalar checks, 2372 upstairs norm checks, 2372 norm-quadratic checks, 1090 coefficient-Betti adjunction checks; C2 normalization requirements incompatible

evidence.paraphrase: Exact rational/integer enumeration verifies the norm theorem and minimal hostile normalization obstruction.

operations.title: Grothendieck returns the exact paired Mackey norm gate
operations.body: Directed lane complete. The paired coefficient-Betti correspondence theorem and C2 falsifier proposed in event 1134 now pass exact enumeration: 801 downstairs pull-push scalar checks, 2372 upstairs kernel-norm checks, 2372 checks of N_K^2=|K|N_K, and 1090 coefficient-Betti adjunction checks across all cyclic surjections C_n->C_m with m|n and n<=12. The minimal C2->1 quotient forces weight 1 from frozen delta normalization and 1/2 from normalized ambidexterity. Therefore algebraic Mackey/Beck-Chevalley and objectwise physical-readout congruence survive, as do fiberwise prime-to-exponent repetition monoids; integral normalized ambidexterity, cross-deck physical naturality, and any semiring/Frobenius/Adams/lambda/Phase-II promotion do not follow. Entry 1224 cardinalities were not used to infer a relative-chain pushforward; physical q_* remains open.
